whoItsFor: Designers, founders and developers who use Claude, Gemini CLI, Codex or other Agent Skills-compatible AI agents to create logos and brand identities from a brief through to production SVG files.
useCases: Turn a client brief into concepts, then refine and test them through a checkpoint before building the full kit
Audit an SVG logo against design principles and test it at 16 px, in one colour, reversed and on competitor shelves
Export a favicon, app-icon and web-manifest set from a finished logo
